answer.title: Automate Quote Lead Creation
answer.trigger: An email arrives with a new quote request from a customer.
steps: Receive the new quote request email.
Extract the customer details and job description from the email.
Create a new lead in the CRM using the extracted details.
answer.ai_help: Extracts the customer's name, contact info, and job description from the incoming email text.
answer.risk_reason: If the automation makes a mistake, an incorrect lead is created in the CRM which can be easily edited or deleted.
